brokers.empty: Run a cluster check to see broker status

warn.latency: Response latency above average. Check the network to this host.

healthy.title: Cluster healthy
healthy.details: All brokers online, no under-replicated partitions, lag is stable.

offline_partitions.title: Critical: offline partitions
offline_partitions.details: {{offline}} partition(s) have no available leader — producers cannot write. Immediate action required.

brokers_down.title: Critical: brokers unavailable

error_rate_high.title: Error rate elevated
error_rate_high.details: {{error_rate}}% of messages failed in the period. Check the failing nodes below.

lag_high.title: Consumer lag is high
lag_high.details: Current lag is {{lag}}. The consumer is falling behind the producer — check Sender.

lag_growing.title: Attention: lag is growing faster than it is consumed
lag_growing.details: Current lag {{lag}} is rising. Sender is consuming slower than the producer writes — check Sender load.

under_replicated.title: Attention: under-replicated partitions
under_replicated.details: {{under_replicated}} partition(s) are under-replicated. Some replicas are behind or unavailable.

produce_latency_high.title: Produce latency elevated
produce_latency_high.details: Processing p95 latency is above the threshold. Check broker and Sender load.

kafka.rate_limited: Too many requests, try again in a minute.

validation.incoming_method: Invalid incoming method (allowed: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
validation.outgoing_method: Invalid outgoing method (allowed: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
validation.path_length: Path length must be between 1 and 255 characters
validation.path_format: Path may contain only latin letters, digits, slash, hyphen and underscore, and must start with a letter or digit
validation.target_url_required: Target URL is required when URL mode is «static»
validation.target_url_length: Target URL must be at most 2048 characters
validation.target_url_self: Target URL must not point at the Nexus ingress itself (would cause a request loop)
validation.url_param_name_length: URL parameter name length must be between 1 and 64 characters
validation.url_param_name_format: URL parameter name must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore
validation.auth_dynamic_field_length: Dynamic auth field name length must be between 1 and 64 characters
validation.auth_dynamic_field_format: Dynamic auth field name must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore
validation.auth_dynamic_source: Dynamic auth source must be header or query
validation.timeout_ms: Timeout must be between 100 and 300000 ms
validation.retry_count: Retry count must be between 0 and 10
validation.retry_backoff_ms: Retry backoff must be between 0 and 60000 ms
validation.allowed_hosts_size: Allowed hosts list must have at most 50 entries
validation.forward_headers_size: Forward headers list must have at most 30 entries
validation.webhook_sig_header_length: Signature header name must be at most 128 characters
validation.webhook_sig_prefix_length: Signature prefix must be at most 64 characters
validation.webhook_sig_header_required: Signature header is required for webhook_signature auth
validation.webhook_sig_secret_required: Secret is required for webhook_signature auth
validation.template_id: ClickHouse template id must be a valid UUID
validation.logs_not_configured: Logging is enabled but no ClickHouse table name is set — pick a template or set the table name
validation.max_body_size_range: Max body size must be between 0 and 10000000 bytes
validation.max_body_size_required: Max body size must be greater than 0 when the limit is enabled
validation.rmq_queue: RabbitMQ queue name must be 1..255 characters and contain only letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore
validation.pull_interval_sec: Pull interval must be between 1 and 3600 seconds
validation.pull_batch_size: Pull batch size must be between 1 and 1000
validation.pull_prefetch: Pull prefetch must be between 1 and 1000
validation.dlq_ttl_seconds: DLQ TTL must be between 60 and 2592000 seconds
validation.dlq_retry_delay_seconds: Retry delay must be between 1 and 86400 seconds

fields.ch_template_hint: Pick a template — the log table is created automatically on save. Leave empty to manage the table manually.

webhook.hint: Receive webhooks at POST /v1/callback/{path}. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using the secret above, hex-encoded, optionally prefixed (e.g. "sha256=") and placed in the header.

auth.basic_in_hint: Format: login:password separated by a colon (e.g. admin:s3cret). The client sends Authorization: Basic base64(login:password) — no need to base64-encode here.
auth.basic_out_hint: Format: login:password separated by a colon (e.g. admin:s3cret). Nexus base64-encodes it and sets Authorization: Basic … on the request to the node.
auth.token_in_hint: Token value only, without the "Bearer " prefix. The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.
auth.token_out_hint: Token value only, without the "Bearer " prefix. Nexus sets Authorization: Bearer <token> on the request to the node.
auth.token_from_request_hint: The token is taken from the incoming request (query / header / body field) and placed into Authorization: Bearer on the request to the node; the original value is stripped from the proxied request.
auth.basic_from_request_hint: The incoming Authorization: Basic … header is forwarded to the node as-is (Nexus stores no credentials).

form.forward_headers_hint: which headers to pass to the target node
form.incoming_method_hint: HTTP method the node accepts; other methods get 405
form.outgoing_method_hint: HTTP method used to call the target
form.max_body_hint: max characters; request/response are truncated to this value
form.ssrf_warn: "From request" mode: fill the host allowlist to prevent SSRF. Do not leave it empty in production.
form.comment_hint: internal note for your team; not visible to external clients
form.comment_placeholder: E.g., integration with system X, sends order events…
form.dlq_retry_delay_hint: minimum wait before re-attempting a failed delivery; default 5 min

rmq.host_hint: 5672 for AMQP, 5671 for AMQPS. The TLS certificate must be trusted.
rmq.queue_hint: The queue must already exist and be bound to the exchange. Nexus does not create queues in v1.
rmq.interval_hint: How often the worker fetches a batch. Allowed 1–3600.
rmq.prefetch_hint: AMQP basic.qos. Defaults to the batch size.
rmq.degraded_desc: Cannot reach RabbitMQ or the queue is missing. Messages are not lost — they stay in the queue. The node returns to active automatically once the connection recovers.

headers_combo.invalid: Invalid name: latin letters, digits and - _ . ! # $ % & ' * + ^ ` | ~, 1–100 chars.

allowed_hosts.label: Allowed hosts
allowed_hosts.hint_short: patterns from the catalog; a URL outside the list → 403
allowed_hosts.add_placeholder: Add a host from the catalog…
allowed_hosts.not_found: Nothing found. Create patterns in Settings → Allowed hosts.
allowed_hosts.hint: Manage the catalog in Settings → Allowed hosts.
allowed_hosts.ssrf_desc: Without an allowlist a client can make the bus call internal services. Add at least one pattern or use Static mode.

replay.body_label: Request body (leave empty to reuse original)
replay.sync: Sync instead of async (wait for the response here)
replay.security: Tokens and Basic creds from the original are not restored (already *** in the log). Enter them manually if needed.

dryrun.title: Test request (dry-run)
dryrun.subtitle: config is not saved · no production logs are written

logs.not_configured: Logging is not configured for this node — no clickhouse_table set. Pick a ClickHouse template in node settings (the log table is created automatically) or set the table name manually.
logs.live_lost: Live stream lost — re-enable to reconnect

queue.unavailable: Kafka queue is unavailable (cluster not configured).
queue.capped_hint: Showing the first of a limited scan — the queue may be larger.
queue.purge_all_confirm: Delete all waiting messages from the queue? They will not be sent to the target.
queue.purge_period_confirm: Delete waiting messages received in the selected period? They will not be sent.
queue.purge_failed_all_confirm: Clear all failed deliveries? Their automatic retry stops and the records are removed from the logs. This cannot be undone.
queue.purge_failed_period_confirm: Clear failed deliveries in the selected period? Their automatic retry stops and the records are removed from the logs. This cannot be undone.

kpi.pending_hint: Messages still sitting in the Kafka queue (not yet consumed). Normally 0; grows when the node is paused or the Sender is down. Admin only.
kpi.failed_hint: Requests that were delivered to the target and failed (from the logs) over the selected period.

banner.explain: Failed deliveries stay in the logs (with reason and body) and can be replayed. To stop the growth, pause or disable the node; to remove them and stop the automatic retry, use “Clear failed”. The dead-letter backlog expires by retention.
banner.disable_confirm: Disable the node? It will stop accepting and delivering requests until re-enabled.
banner.state_paused: The node is paused — new requests pile up in the queue below and are not delivered. Resume to drain it, or purge it.
banner.state_disabled: The node is disabled — incoming requests are rejected (nothing is queued).

failed.empty: No failed deliveries in this period.
failed.no_logging: Logging is not configured for this node — failed deliveries can't be shown.
failed.reprocess_hint: Retried automatically until TTL ({{hours}} h) — once the target recovers, they are delivered. “Replay” forces an immediate retry.

queue.empty_enabled: Empty — an active node delivers right away, so nothing waits here. Undelivered requests are under “Failed deliveries” below.
queue.empty_paused: Nothing queued yet — while the node is paused, new requests pile up here.
